description: Cross-language vectors for author attestation bundle verification (§4.7.11): the identity cases and the bundle cases. Generated by test/vectors/attestation_bundles_test.go from the sigstoreharness fixture instance; regenerate with UPDATE_ATTESTATION_VECTORS=1 go test ./test/vectors/ -run TestAttestationVectors. Each case verifies bundle, a Sigstore bundle as stored, under the instance it names, whose trusted root is in roots, and then compares the certificate with signer. accepted is normative for every implementation. reason is the §4.7.11 refusal reason the Go verifier reports; an SDK whose library refuses the bundle at another step reports its own refusal. attested_time is the earliest verified time of an accepted bundle, in RFC 3339. The sample cases carry real bundles and the trusted roots of their instances from 2026-11-26. Each subjects entry states whether the statement lists a subject with that name and that sha256 value under the §4.7.11 subject rules. The bundles carry no time later than the fixture clock, so they verify at any later date.
